english.note: This is the all-purpose choice: a body part can 痕 when it feels itchy, and an irritant can 痕 someone when it causes itching.
Use this when the body part itself has a tickly or itchy sensation, rather than when someone is touching it.

examples.english: After eating seafood, my whole body starts to itch.
examples.traditional: 我食完海鮮之後，成身都好痕。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 hoi2 sin1 zi1 hau6 seng4 san1 dou1 hou2 han4

examples.english: For some reason, my arm keeps feeling as though someone might tickle it.
examples.traditional: 我隻手臂唔知點解成日痕。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 bei3 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 seng4 jat6 han4
